description: This Java class is a Spring configuration class for setting up a batch job that sends messages to an SMS gateway. It defines beans for the job, its steps, and the tasklet that executes the message sending logic, wiring in necessary dependencies such as repositories, services, and configuration utilities.

classes.name: SendMessageToSmsGatewayConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up batch job to send messages to SMS gateway.

methods.name: sendMessageToSmsGatewayStep
methods.description: Defines the batch step that executes the tasklet for sending messages.

methods.name: sendMessageToSmsGatewayJob
methods.description: Defines the batch job that includes the send message step.

methods.name: sendMessageToSmsGatewayTasklet
methods.description: Creates and returns the tasklet responsible for sending SMS messages.
